name: Text
description: Standalone text section — heading, body copy, optional icon, and optional CTAs — without a dedicated image column. Use for centered copy sections, introductory paragraphs, or supporting text between other blocks. Don't use when there is a prominent image alongside the text (use marquee or columns instead).
visualSignals: No prominent image, purely typographic content. May have a small icon above or beside the heading.

cols.contains: h2 heading + p body + a link (all in one colspan=2 cell)

domInput.notes: Both the name row cell AND the content cell use colspan='2'. The table always has a logical width of 2 columns even though all content is in a single cell. For text-only sections without images, this is almost always the right block.
